Good day
We sent a SAR proposing 9005 backed by 9002.0 2025/09/02 and 7867.0 2024/10/04 for the transfer date of 03/09/2025 on the 29/12/2025 but have yet to receive a response. Please can you take a look and respond to our dispute.


 If we do not receive a response within a week, we will look to resolve this dispute internally and inform the customer that we have been unable to reach an agreement with yourselves. 


Thanks
The OVO Energy Team
Hi team, can you verbally agree on the proposal read 9005 backed by 9002.0 2025/09/02 and 7867.0 2024/10/04 for COS date 03/09/2025, thanks
hello, there is no ONJOB in PFV, so we are unable to provide ONJOB. Thanks
hello, there is no ONJOB in PFV, so we are unable to provide ONJOB. Thanks
Hi team, as you are not able to provide the photo of the meter than please provide the ONJOB, thanks.
Hi team, please provide photo of the meter to validate your alt proposal. thanks
Hello, we don't have meter photo.Thanks
Hi Team, we are closing supplier so please chase your customer for photo of meter Thanks.
Hi team, we have a customer submission of 9443 m3 7/09. Can you send us a picture of the reading ?

Hello, this MPRN (7742887606) has an incorrect transfer read on (3-Sep-25). We believe it should be (9002). We only have one back read within a year of the CoS date which is (9002 – 7867). As we only have one back read, we cannot raise a SARs. Would you be able to verbally agree the new CoS read instead?  We have already raised this through communication SC01696320.
